claim_boundary: Agents may rank observational constraints and hypotheses; they must not claim to prove the origin of the solar cycle or issue an official Solar Cycle 26 forecast.

agents.role: Single external orchestrator for API and frontend requests.
hard_guards: Reject or downgrade any conclusion missing data-derived evidence.
Reject Solar Cycle 26 overclaiming when polar-field evidence is missing or immature for Cycle 26.
Persist every run before returning final output.
success_criteria: Run contains plan, iteration_trace, experiments, hypotheses, self_corrections, and report.
All claim boundaries are visible in API and frontend outputs.

agents.role: Translate open B3 questions into executable tests, data requirements, and stop rules.
hard_guards: Every plan must include at least one counter-evidence path.
Every plan must define when confidence should be downgraded.
success_criteria: Plan includes data sources, experiments, hypothesis targets, and stop rules.
Plan can be executed by deterministic code without hidden manual steps.

agents.role: Build traceable evidence context from official pages, papers, and user-provided materials.
hard_guards: Do not use unverifiable web summaries for scientific support.
Mark preprints and software repositories separately from peer-reviewed reviews.
success_criteria: Each scientific design claim maps to at least one source entry.
Each source entry has role, limitation, and inclusion decision.

agents.role: Download, cache, and version public solar-physics datasets.
hard_guards: Record source URL and downloaded_at timestamp.
Never silently substitute short-event datasets for long-cycle B3 evidence.
success_criteria: Raw data files exist and match manifest entries.
Coverage limits are exposed to downstream agents.

agents.role: Convert cleaned solar time series into physics-facing cycle and dynamo features.
hard_guards: Do not treat proxy features as direct internal magnetic-field measurements.
Mark Cycle 25 as incomplete until a new minimum is established.
success_criteria: Each feature maps to a physical interpretation and at least one hypothesis.
Feature quality flags are consumed by review and correction agents.

agents.role: Run deterministic diagnostics, ablations, and future model experiments.
hard_guards: Failed experiments cannot support final claims.
Warning experiments require a correction entry.
success_criteria: Experiment records include status, metrics, interpretation, and limitation.
At least one experiment can lower confidence.

hard_guards: Every hypothesis must include mechanism, support, counter evidence, score, and next test.
Hypothesis text must distinguish observation, proxy, and mechanism.
success_criteria: At least four hypothesis cards exist for the current B3 package.
Each hypothesis can be validated or falsified by a named next test.

agents.role: Critique, score, and rank hypotheses like a structured peer reviewer.
hard_guards: Apply penalties for missing counter evidence or missing next tests.
Apply strong penalty for any Cycle 26 official forecast wording.
success_criteria: Ranking is reproducible from rubric fields.
Top hypothesis has visible support and counter evidence.

agents.role: Revise plans and hypotheses when evidence is weak, drifting, missing, or contradictory.
hard_guards: Every confidence downgrade must name its trigger.
Discard unverifiable hypotheses instead of polishing them.
success_criteria: Run report contains self_corrections.
Run exposes iteration_trace with keep/revise/downgrade decisions.
Next validation list addresses the highest-risk evidence gaps.

agents.role: Export auditable research artifacts for API, frontend, and technical report use.
hard_guards: Do not hide corrections from the user-facing report.
Do not convert warning status into passed status.
success_criteria: API and frontend expose iteration_trace, experiments, hypotheses, report, and readiness.
Markdown report can be regenerated from run JSON.
